key_catalyst: Pre-earnings anxiety over AI CapEx ROI ahead of remaining Mag-7 reports, compounded by stagflationary macro headwinds and Fed rate hike jitters
reasoning: The market is experiencing a broadening sell-off in mega-cap tech as AI CapEx scrutiny spreads ahead of remaining Mag-7 earnings, compounding the negative reactions seen on July 23 and 24.
